transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I guess... I just haven't been feeling great. For a long time now, I've just been walking around with this flat, heavy feeling. Even if work is going fine or people are nice to me, I just... I still feel down. Kind of empty most days, I guess. That's mainly it.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... a while, I guess. Probably about two years and two months. It kind of started back when... I had this dashboard project at work. It put me in the spotlight a lot, and... yeah. Just been like this since then.
Do you still find pleasure in activities or hobbies that you used to enjoy?
Not really. I don't know, I just... don't really do much anymore.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
Um... I don't know. I guess I just feel... down, mostly. Not really worried about anything in particular. Just tired.
Have you ever thought about ending your life?
No... um, I haven't. I don't really think about that. Just... no.
Do you feel like you're moving slower or faster than you used to?
Um... I don't really know. I guess I'm just... normal? I haven't really paid attention to that.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
Um... no. I haven't really noticed. I don't really weigh myself, so... I guess it's about the same.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I mean... I don't really have anything to feel guilty about, I guess. So... no.
Have you had periods in your life where you felt normal or even really good, in between times when you felt down?
Um... I don't know. Not really. It just... kind of feels the same most of the time, I guess. I don't really remember feeling really good, so... yeah.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't?
Um... no. I've never had anything like that happen. So... no.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or look forward to?
Um... not really. I don't know. I just kind of... get through the day, I guess. There isn't really anything that comes to mind. So... no.
Are there things that you used to enjoy that you still enjoy a little bit, even if it's not as much as before?
I mean... I don't think so. I can't really think of anything. It's all just... kind of flat, I guess. So, no.
Do you often feel irritable?
Um... not really. I don't think I get mad that much. Just... mostly tired, I guess. So... no.
Do you feel like you have less energy or motivation to do things than you used to?

Yeah... definitely. Um, usually by the afternoon, I'm just... so wiped out. Like, even just trying to fix a simple spreadsheet error at work, or... finishing up expense paperwork... it's just hard. Even getting myself to soccer... it just feels like I'm dragging my body and my brain through mud. So... yeah. Just no energy.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are not your own or that someone or something is controlling your mind?
Um... no. I haven't ever felt like that. It's just... my own thoughts, I guess. So, no.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your sleep patterns?
Um... no, I don't think so. I mean... I sleep about the same as always, I guess. Nothing really different.
Have you had any periods in the last two years where your symptoms were significantly worse than they are now?
Um... no, not really. It's just... pretty much always like this. I haven't really noticed it getting way worse or anything. It's just kind of... steady, I guess.
Would you say that your feelings of being down and empty are mild, moderate, or severe most of the time?

Um... I guess maybe moderate. It's just... for a really long time now, I've had this... flat, heavy feeling. Even if things at work are fine or people are being nice, I still just feel down. Kind of empty, most days. So... yeah, moderate, probably.
Are there any activities that you used to think about or look forward to, but now you don't?

Um... I guess so. I used to... I used to have these plans for getting my MBA, like, mapped out pretty specifically. Career steps and stuff. But... lately, I just kind of look at them and... I don't know. I just figure I won't actually get there. Doesn't really matter how hard I try, so... I don't really think about it much anymore.
